[LSIG.4.4] Every v1 aggregation may assert exact equality in conformance
fixtures, on every platform and in every mode. The golden vectors — the
integer-exact `active_fraction` path, the `integral` rectangle sum and
`K = 128` recompute, `onset_rate`'s `min(W, elapsed)` warm-up denominator,
and the default↔`realtime` divergence of §[LSIG.5] — are authored in
`specs/conformance/SERIES_SIGNAL_VECTORS.md`.
